seed_rules.zrstarts: Initialize state to supplied long and modulus/multiplier to fixed constants.
seed_rules.zrstart: Reduce arbitrary-length supplied seed modulo modulus.

original_freelip_rng.zrandom_bound: bound=M-(M mod b); repeat state=A*state mod M until state<bound; output state mod b.
original_freelip_rng.zrandomb_assembly: Use one more radix limb than bound; fill high limb first using zrandom(RADIX); reduce resulting integer modulo supplied bound.

p521_middle_limb_deduction.model: 22 successive accepted low-26-bit FreeLIP outputs, high limb first, concatenated into U<2**572, then reduced modulo p.
p521_middle_limb_deduction.proof: U=Gx+q*p, 0<=q<=2**51. Since Gx mod 2**52 >2**51, subtracting q does not borrow across bit 52. Therefore bits 52..519 of U equal those of Gx.

lrand48_31bit_in_32bit_slots_exclusion.model: Seventeen successive 31-bit lrand48 outputs, each held in a32-bit slot, concatenated and reduced modulo2**521−1.
lrand48_31bit_in_32bit_slots_exclusion.proof: The quotient correction cannot borrow across bit32. Every raw slot top bit is zero, but fixed Gx bit63 is one. Thus no state satisfies this assembly. Reversing whole slot order preserves the zero-bit obstruction; byte swaps within a slot require separate contracts.
